errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are at intervals of 0.25. The '1e9' (or 10⁹) is a multiplier for the entire axis, not part of the interval value. The description incorrectly incorporates the multiplier into the interval.

The Vanilla model reaches a loss of 2.50 at approximately 1.22 × 10⁹ TFLOPs, not at the end of the axis range (1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs).
The final data point for the SepLLM model is at approximately 1.22 × 10⁹ TFLOPs, not at the end of the axis range (1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs).
